title: Stage 3A-B sealed reference-only core
scope_status: sealed B core only; not a complete Stage 3A implementation

expected_commit.message: feat: add sealed enclosure acoustic reference solver
expected_commit.final_commit: pending; record in a later closeout without self-reference

implemented.pressure_space: only audited physical air_* triangles; rigid_* triangles are excluded
implemented.sealed_components: B cavity and exterior retain separate pressure DOF components
implemented.internal_interfaces: shared conforming pressure mesh DOFs; no pressure-release shortcut
implemented.front_back_trace_normals: computed from each pressure triangle outward toward rigid, not guessed by side sign
implemented.low_level_operators: public ordinary axisymmetric P1 K and compressibility C assembly for independent eigenmode checks

formulas.prescribed_velocity_flux: dp/dn = -i*omega*rho*(v dot n); Q_out = integral v dot n dS; Q_into = -Q_out
formulas.pml: R=sqrt(r^2+z^2), s_R=1-i*alpha*eta^m, tilde_R from the same stretch integral, s_t=tilde_R/R; gradient radial=s_t^2/s_R, tangential=s_R, mass=s_R*s_t^2
formulas.pml_geometry: R0=0.35 m, R1=0.45 m from sealed B config; PML applies only to air_pml_front/rear

covers: ordinary K/C independent Neumann eigenmode gradient check
PML coefficient interface and exp(+i omega t) absorption sign
PML geometry location and mislabelled-triangle rejection
sealed B L1/L2 low-frequency analytic limit
front/back trace separation and wrong case/tag rejection

verification.b_low_frequency_interpretation: These sealed-B low-frequency values verify the 2*pi*r flux integration, front/back sign convention, and sealed analytic limit; they do not validate the gradient operator. The independent cylinder eigenmode below is the separate gradient-assembly and mesh-convergence validation.

independent_cylinder.radial_mode_separation: small radius chosen so the first radial Neumann mode is higher

gradient_eigenmode.zero_mode: small numerical zero/negative eigenvalue is filtered by a scale-aware positive-eigenvalue threshold
